facts.fact: 清晨挽留：不用问，答案永远是yes
facts.anchor: “You don’t have to ask because the answer is always yes. I want to spend time with you. I want you to stay with me.”

facts.fact: 同居提案：东西搬过来，就不用两头跑
facts.anchor: if you kept your stuff here, you wouldn’t have to spend as much time running from one place to the other.

facts.fact: 现状：还没告诉哥哥，因此对朋友也继续保密
facts.anchor: She had yet to tell her brother about us. And until she did, we planned to continue to keep this a secret from our friends.

facts.fact: 她坦白：小概率会搬到加州（Anaheim）
facts.anchor: “I’m not supposed to say anything because it might not even happen, but there’s a small chance I’m moving to California.”

facts.fact: 转会僵局：Wolves想续约，Anaheim也想要她
facts.anchor: “My contract with the Wolves expired at the end of last season. They want to re-sign me, but so does Anaheim.”

facts.fact: 两份offer相当——这才是她难决定的真因
facts.anchor: “Yes,” she sighed. “Which is why I’m having such a tough time making a decision.”

facts.fact: 她承认LA的吸引力之一：你在这里
Anaheim优势：投入大、设施好、承诺给她队长
facts.anchor: Anaheim has invested a lot into the team and the facilities.

facts.fact: 她把转会秘密只告诉了Carson
他的立场：你决定，我支持，无论哪样
facts.anchor: “You’ll make the best decision for you. And I’ll be here, supporting that decision, no matter what it is.”

facts.fact: 他说上赛季“我们其实在一起”——异地从未阻碍
facts.anchor: “We were in every way that mattered.”

facts.fact: 他重申：规则我们自己定
关系的最优解由两人共同裁定
facts.anchor: “What’s best for our relationship is whatever we decide,”
“Come sit on my face, and I’ll show you.”

facts.fact: 她真约他去客队更衣室——他没想到她敢
facts.anchor: I’d once joked about having a quickie in the locker room, but I didn’t think she’d ever take me up on it.

facts.fact: 洗澡间里Boone宣布想约Logan——她正在他身下
facts.anchor: “I’m thinking about asking Logan out,” Boone said

facts.fact: 他对着Boone说“她有人在交往”，同时手指进入她
facts.anchor: “I think she’s actually seeing someone.” I pushed a finger inside her

facts.fact: 他的“serious”是对着Logan说的——正式升级
facts.anchor: “Yeah,” I said. “I do. And I think it’s serious.” But I was looking at Logan as I said the words.
